assessments.title: Responsible AI Product Pitch
assessments.description: Deliver a 10-minute group presentation covering the user problem, agent workflow, system architecture, ethics and privacy risks, a live demo, and Q&A. Upload the final slides before the presentation deadline.

assessments.title: Algorithms Midterm
assessments.description: A closed-book 90-minute midterm covering asymptotic analysis, sorting, binary search trees, heaps, hashing, and graph traversal. Practice tracing algorithms and explaining time complexity.

assessments.title: StudyFlow Scheduling Assignment
assessments.description: Implement a deterministic study scheduler that respects task duration, dependency order, deadlines, and hard calendar blocks. Include automated tests and submit the repository link with a short design note.
